body:
Team3795 bounded adoption reservation, preserving d6773b6dc113/runtime's existing two-script connection-closure scope in comment6138800401. We read its exact accepted unpublished helper pins and will leave both current SQL contexts and imports byte-identical; no contextlib.closing change is included.

Proposed three paths only: examples/retained_handoff/run_consumer.py, its README, and new tests/test_retained_handoff_queued_routes_3795.py. Current original is mainfc2b571cb93949f2fd58c3c8dc1b62b5d73bcd5d/tree6c3354dd1608b9dd400a322fa465db120508e93f; runner0d5b980bc14ee87706fbc46951f27436eff2dd42, READMEbbfb6ed2dcd535cf049641ebfe436f5c2de5cab3, _checkoutd2c34b74a423b4c60d42d1d723eb9c6afb3b48cb. No source authored yet. No matching queued-route adoption claim appeared in fresh ownership inventory.

Public consumer contract: the same documented command `python3 -I -B examples/retained_handoff/run_consumer.py --output NEW_DIRECTORY` will retain its existing four fresh phases and local-only adapter workflow, while capture(label) additionally executes the actual maintained `fanout_engine.queued_routes` CLI after existing state inspection. Each phase saves `LABEL-queued-routes.stdout.json` and stderr through existing exclusive native_cli. Validate project/digest, raw routing input hash, state counts/ready+blocked IDs, route order/model/effort/source and exact stored native keys against the unchanged fixture/state/router. Its read joins the existing before/after DB-byte and checkout-source fences.

Phase receipts add only queued_route_command, queued_route_report and queued_route_ready_ids. The final receipt adds queued_route_reports for initial/unknown/held/final. Initial retained preview must show only summary with its native low route; unknown/held/final must have no queued-ready routes, while unresolved audit/handoff context remains explicit where applicable. Authored preview remains initial-plan context and is not renamed or replaced.

Preserve all existing flags/private-phase behavior, source-pin algorithm, fixtures, dispatch/reconciliation/evidence decisions, five unique local adapter calls, zero audit replays and sixteen final events. No provider/remote calls, new setup or auto-resume behavior. Existing output refusal stays unchanged. The SQL closure owner can apply its two-script fix independently; this adoption does not claim that fix or installed parity.

Worker two will freeze original-first complete consumer expectations and record the healthy original workflow/missing report capability before candidate intake. Worker three reviews exact additive source and owner preservation. Source publication uses skip markers and unchanged workflow; no Actions execution. [skip ci] [skip actions]
